nmap.acquisition: Operator-provided executable; no bundled Nmap code or data; reject version mismatch.
nmap.limitations: Only native loopback connect fixtures are directly comparable. Injected packet fixtures are not offered as Nmap runtime evidence.

scenarios.condition: An exact checksum-valid direct response reverses the sent tuple; TCP SYN/ACK acknowledges sequence+1, UDP echoes the exact payload, ICMP echoes the identity.
scenarios.divergence: ICMP open is an attempt observation, not Nmap's host-up vocabulary. UDP open does not identify a service.

scenarios.condition: TCP endpoint sends a correlated RST/ACK; UDP and ICMP receive an exact quoted ICMP port-unreachable error.
scenarios.divergence: TCP reset and endpoint-quoted UDP port-unreachable establish refusal. An echo probe has no port: its quoted destination-unreachable establishes unreachable attempt evidence, not a closed port. No service identity is claimed.

scenarios.condition: The fixture router sends an exact quoted administrative rejection: ICMPv4 type 3 code 13 or ICMPv6 type 1 code 1.
scenarios.divergence: A router's rejection is not a direct target host observation. This fixture models an explicit rejection, not silent packet dropping.

scenarios.condition: The recording provider accepts one transmission and emits no captured frame for the entire bounded response window.
scenarios.divergence: PacketcraftR retains silence as timeout; Nmap may infer filtered for SYN or open|filtered for UDP. Neither establishes host absence.

scenarios.condition: The fixture emits a truncated IP header (one byte identifying IPv4 or IPv6), which cannot decode into a correlated reply.
scenarios.divergence: The acquisition record preserves the exact malformed byte. A tolerant dissector may represent it as unmatched raw data rather than a decode error, and the scanner does not retain every unrelated capture. Neither representation establishes a port state; timeout is expected despite one capture delivery.

scenarios.condition: The fixture emits a checksum-valid direct-looking reply with a different TCP/UDP destination port or ICMP echo identity.
scenarios.divergence: Captured but unrelated traffic is not attributed to the attempt, even when its address and transport match.

native_connect_scenarios.condition: A listener bound exclusively to the declared loopback address accepts the TCP handshake on an ephemeral port.
native_connect_scenarios.divergence: Neither successful handshake authenticates application identity.

native_connect_scenarios.condition: A loopback socket reserves an ephemeral TCP port without listening; it stays bound until the attempt completes.
native_connect_scenarios.divergence: The reserved port avoids the close-and-rebind race; the fixture condition, not Nmap, is the oracle.

traceroute_scenarios.condition: A checksum-valid direct reply to the first and only authorized hop proves the destination answered.
traceroute_scenarios.divergence: This one-hop fixture measures existing traceroute execution; it does not imply multi-host or scan-informed path reuse.

traceroute_scenarios.condition: No frame arrives for the first and only authorized hop; the bounded trace retains silence, not host absence.
traceroute_scenarios.divergence: Silence at a hop is an observation. It does not identify a router or prove a blocked destination.

target_planning_scenarios.condition: The same three numeric declarations are supplied as arguments, or one positional address followed by a two-line file/stdin manifest. A /30 contains all four addresses, including its numeric endpoints; no target or neighbor work is needed.
target_planning_scenarios.divergence: No Nmap shorthand or implicit DNS is used. Original declaration order and physical manifest lines remain observable, independent of any Nmap rendering.

target_planning_scenarios.condition: A four-address numeric /30 excludes its middle two addresses. Separately, one IPv4 and one IPv6 declaration are narrowed to IPv4.
target_planning_scenarios.divergence: Numeric exclusion and family filters define the expected selection without resolution or probes; network and broadcast numeric values are not silently removed.

target_planning_scenarios.condition: Malformed/oversized include and exclusion manifests are rejected before policy or providers. Exact repeated declarations coalesce, preserving all source labels and physical lines; one stdin consumer is admitted across all input roles.
target_planning_scenarios.divergence: Bounded one-declaration-per-line manifests deliberately differ from unbounded or Nmap-specific input grammars. Errors and warnings retain PacketcraftR classifications.

target_planning_scenarios.condition: A real assigned unicast link-local IPv6 address is named with its interface name and IPv6 index. A TCP listener and raw UDP receiver are bound only to that same local scoped address; no adapter mutation or external destination is allowed.

expected.raw: exact UDP payload delivery or typed capability.unsupported

target_planning_scenarios.divergence: Name/index aliases identify one interface, not two targets. A successful socket is handshake evidence only. macOS complete-header raw IPv6 is unsupported, not a network timeout; unavailable host fixtures do not count as proof.

target_planning_scenarios.condition: Inside a fresh Linux namespace, two independent veth links share the same link-local source and peer addresses. Only the first link hosts the TCP listener and exact raw TCP SYN responder; interface-name/index aliases select the same first link.
target_planning_scenarios.divergence: The provisioned listener/responder, not Nmap output, defines connected/open and refused/closed ground truth. Equal IPv6 bytes on distinct links must remain distinct endpoint identities.

discovery_scenarios.condition: Target answers echo, SYN, and UDP discovery with independently constructed protocol-matching replies.
discovery_scenarios.measurement_scope: Discovery and scan share authorization, finite attempts, pacing, duration, probe and evidence budgets; native paths are reported separately from injected providers.

discovery_scenarios.condition: Target answers echo and refuses TCP/UDP ports; a closed endpoint does not imply an absent host.
discovery_scenarios.measurement_scope: Discovery and scan share authorization, finite attempts, pacing, duration, probe and evidence budgets; native paths are reported separately from injected providers.

discovery_scenarios.condition: On-link peer sends no answer; silence remains uncertainty, never absence.
discovery_scenarios.measurement_scope: Discovery and scan share authorization, finite attempts, pacing, duration, probe and evidence budgets; native paths are reported separately from injected providers.

discovery_scenarios.condition: Router emits administrative-prohibition errors quoting the exact probe; router evidence is not a target response.
discovery_scenarios.measurement_scope: Discovery and scan share authorization, finite attempts, pacing, duration, probe and evidence budgets; native paths are reported separately from injected providers.

discovery_scenarios.condition: Off-link target is reached through a router which reports it unreachable; explicit neighbor discovery must not solicit or identify the gateway as the target.
discovery_scenarios.measurement_scope: Discovery and scan share authorization, finite attempts, pacing, duration, probe and evidence budgets; native paths are reported separately from injected providers.

discovery_scenarios.condition: Two same-family on-link targets answer ARP/NDP with one link address; report possible proxy, not authenticated identities.
discovery_scenarios.measurement_scope: Discovery and scan share authorization, finite attempts, pacing, duration, probe and evidence budgets; native paths are reported separately from injected providers.

adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.condition: A checksum-valid direct response is delivered on the first attempt. Separate hosts have independently provisioned 10 ms and 100 ms reply delays.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.expected: Each answered endpoint sends exactly once even with an attempt ceiling of three. First-attempt samples update that scoped host's RTT estimate; unsampled hosts use the operation estimate. Retry samples never update the estimator.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.measurement_scope: behavioral contract; M2 single-probe matrix supplies preservation measurements, not throughput acceptance

adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.condition: One endpoint never replies and another replies on its first attempt, with an attempt ceiling of three and retry backoff 100 ms capped at one second.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.expected: Only the silent endpoint is retried: at most three starts, with retry readiness at least 100 ms and then 200 ms after settlement. A not-ready retry does not block ready work for another host.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.measurement_scope: behavioral contract; not native throughput evidence

adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.condition: At least eight probes settle for one scoped host, including at least two correlated control errors from the same responder and at least four silent attempts.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.expected: Publish suspected_response_rate_limit as an inference with bounded cited control/loss probe sequences and counts; pace that host more slowly without extending its deadline. All-silent probes, or control errors from distinct responders or scopes, do not establish this condition.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.measurement_scope: behavioral contract of an inference; filtering and loss remain alternative explanations

adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.condition: Two selected scoped hosts each have three ordered endpoints and a scheduling window of one; all endpoints answer immediately.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.expected: Starts interleave host 1 endpoint 1, host 2 endpoint 1, host 1 endpoint 2, host 2 endpoint 2, host 1 endpoint 3, host 2 endpoint 3. Equal address bytes on different interfaces remain separate host identities.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.measurement_scope: behavioral contract; not native throughput evidence

adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.condition: A silent host spends its finite deadline with endpoints still unsent while a second responsive host completes. Discovery and scan share each host's deadline.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.expected: The expired host reports scan incomplete, not scanned or a fabricated timeout for an unsent endpoint. The second host completes. Neither retries, neighbor work, pacing, nor window changes extend the operation deadline.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.measurement_scope: behavioral contract; not native throughput evidence

adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.condition: Controlled cohorts contain verified replies followed by losses, using an initial window of four with minimum one and operation maximum eight.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.expected: Reply cohorts increase admission conservatively; a lossy cohort halves the window once. The window remains between one and eight, and shrinking does not cancel already admitted work.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.measurement_scope: behavioral contract; a configured window is not achieved concurrency or throughput

adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.condition: A blocked TCP provider outlives cancellation, then returns a socket whose drop is independently controlled. Another operation uses a separate admission budget.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.expected: The canceled work retains both operation and process permits until provider/socket cleanup completes. A pending vector becoming empty does not free a permit; independent operations still obey the shared process ceiling of sixteen.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.measurement_scope: resource-lifetime contract; retaining sixteen is not a validated capacity increase

adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.condition: The selected plan's charged state exceeds max_prepared_bytes; a second plan exactly fits its checked charges. Both use documentation addresses and recording providers.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.expected: The oversized plan fails before any active discovery, transmission, or connect. Retained scheduling state scales with distinct endpoints rather than the attempt ceiling; shared payloads/profiles and scoped identity bytes are charged.
adaptive_scheduling_scenarios.measurement_scope: logical-byte boundary contract; charged bytes are not peak resident memory

identification_scenarios.condition: A speak-first server on a nonstandard TCP port sends SSH-2.0-OpenSSH_9.8p1 with CRLF.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

identification_scenarios.condition: A nonstandard TCP port responds to the reviewed HEAD request with a complete HTTP response and Server: nginx/1.26.2.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

identification_scenarios.condition: A nonstandard UDP port echoes the nonrecursive root DNS question and its transaction ID in a valid response.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

identification_scenarios.condition: Complete HTTP syntax contains an unfamiliar Server claim absent from the selected corpus.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

identification_scenarios.condition: A complete HTTP response advertises both nginx/1.26.2 and Apache/2.4.62 in separate Server fields.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

identification_scenarios.condition: A complete HTTP response advertises conflicting versions of nginx in separate Server fields.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

identification_scenarios.condition: A fixture unrelated to nginx deliberately sends a syntactically valid Server: nginx/99.0 response. The protocol claim is preserved without authenticating the fixture identity.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

identification_scenarios.condition: A response beginning with HTTP/ contains a malformed response head.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

identification_scenarios.condition: An otherwise recognized response ends at its explicit byte or time boundary before a complete record.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

identification_scenarios.condition: An endpoint appears in the reviewed sensitive-service exclusion document.
identification_scenarios.measurement_scope: Independent application evidence contract; a claim is not authenticated identity or a vulnerability finding.

provenance.source: Original PacketcraftR fixture specifications authored in this repository
transforms: Independently specified network conditions; no Nmap database or output used to derive expectations
provenance.license_rationale: Original project-authored fixture specifications distributed under the repository license.
provenance.refresh: Review condition and expected outcome together; increment dataset_version; rerun both IP families and all declared transports and windows. Review identification conditions against the read-only probe corpus; rerun deterministic parsing, workflow budgets and applicable ordinary-socket loopback profiles.
provenance.coverage: Six packet conditions across two IP families, three transports and two scheduling windows; native loopback connected/refused outcomes in both IP families; responsive/silent single-hop traceroutes for both IP families and all three transports; M4 numeric manifest/selection and native scoped host-local/two-link fixture conditions; eight M7 adaptive scheduling behavioral/resource contracts. M7 contracts are not relabeled as cross-platform native performance evidence. Ten M8 application identification conditions cover known nonstandard services, unknown, ambiguous products and versions, deliberately misleading claims, malformed and truncated evidence, and exclusions.
